name: Prefect
summary: Start Ogun runs from Prefect flows with the OgunConnection block and tasks, wait for them and read partition state. Prefect calls Ogun with an agent credential and cannot approve.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: Created once on a terminal: ogun credentials add NAME --kind agent. Default prefect. The token stays in Ogun's state directory.

settings.name: ogun_home
settings.label: Ogun state directory
settings.help: As $OGUN_HOME. The platform default for the worker's user when empty.

settings.name: agent_file
settings.label: Credential file
settings.help: Explicit path of the credential file instead of a name.

settings.name: timeout_s
settings.label: Call timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Socket timeout of one call to ogund.

egress.note: The block reaches ogund through its local socket on the same machine (O-15 section 2); nothing leaves the host. The server bridge (ADR 0010) is for remote workers and this package does not use it yet.

implementation.evidence: Built, not yet run against the real counterpart: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS says Prefect was smoke-tested against a fake daemon.

notes: Package prefect-ogun: block OgunConnection; tasks ogun_run, start_ogun_run, wait_for_ogun_run, ogun_partition_state. The block holds no secret. Pin workflow_hash to the version a person approved.
